description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the ProvisioningEntry entity, providing methods for database access and custom queries related to provisioning entries.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for ProvisioningEntry, enabling CRUD operations and custom queries within the persistence layer.

methods.name: findByProvisioningEntryDate
methods.description: Finds a ProvisioningEntry with the specified created date.

methods.name: findExistingProvisioningEntryWithJournalEntries
methods.description: Finds the most recent ProvisioningEntry where journal entries have been created.

calls: select entry1 from ProvisioningEntry entry1 where entry1.createdDate = :createdDate
select entry1 from ProvisioningEntry entry1 where entry1.createdDate = (select max(entry2.createdDate) from ProvisioningEntry entry2 where entry2.isJournalEntryCreated=true)
